_about: Critical data elements (CDEs). Each has a business definition, a domain (which fixes owner and steward), a criticality that sets its quality target, a classification, and the rules that measure it. Fictional.

cdes.name: Property country
cdes.definition: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country where the property is located; drives tax, legal and search.

cdes.name: Property city
cdes.definition: City shown to guests in search and on the confirmation.

cdes.name: Nightly price
cdes.definition: Base price per night in EUR before taxes and discounts.

cdes.name: Listing verification date
cdes.definition: Date the listing details were last confirmed by the host; older than 180 days counts as stale.

cdes.name: Booking identifier
cdes.definition: Unique key of a booking across all channels.

cdes.name: Booked property
cdes.definition: The property the booking is for; must exist in the listings register.

cdes.name: Stay dates
cdes.definition: Check-in and check-out dates; check-out must be after check-in.

cdes.name: Booking currency
cdes.definition: ISO 4217 currency of the amount charged; supported: EUR, GBP, USD, CHF.

cdes.name: Guest identifier
cdes.definition: Pseudonymous key of the guest; never the guest's name or email.

cdes.name: Guest contact email
cdes.definition: Address used for booking confirmations; values are never copied into reports.
